title: Against the Condenser
summary: Guild water chits expire at dusk — unstamped draw credits are worthless paper and the condenser resets on the hour. Two stops inside Saltmouth before the clock drains: stamp at the tower, bank at the moorage.

objectives.label: Take the unstamped water chits from the exchange
Stamp the chits at the water tower
Bank the stamped chits at the moorage mast

offer.text: Ah, courier. You are thirsty for work and I am holding water. Funny how often those are the same sentence.
The day's draw chits. Unstamped at dusk, they are wallpaper. Stamp them at the tower, bank them at the mast, and mind the clock — the condenser forgives nothing. It's the only honest machine I own.

accept.text: Two minutes, two stops, short ropes. Cut the corner behind the stills if your knees are brave. Go, go — the paper is already dying.

complete.text: Stamped, banked, breathing. You beat my machine, child. Do not make a habit of it — I insure against habits.
You pay me to race your own plumbing.
I pay you to remind Saltmouth that the clock has teeth. The ride is merely educational.
